about: Schedules of the generated three-center kernels (tools/intgen/cuda_eri3c.py), chosen per class by crates/linus-gpu/examples/eri3c_tune.rs: the fastest candidate on the workload, with every candidate's time in ms, registers and local bytes. Classes without an entry use cuda_eri3c.default_schedule. "arch": the records of architectures tuned on their own (sm_XY); where one chooses another schedule than the default's, its variant is generated beside the default and used on devices of that architecture.
